_comment: Radio: That Town, These People (top 3 of every town).
2: Listin' the best three of every town,\nit's That Town, These People!
3: That town, this town, bringin' everybody\ntogether, the Town Channel!
4:
Announcin' the top 3 in New Bark Town!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The wind that blow through town!
There's a wind that'll suddenly blast
through town, like residents know.
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
The weather vanes!
The weather vanes posted around
town let us stay ready for
when the wind gon' blow
through town.
And number one is... Ta-da!
Professor Elm's Lab!
Professor Elm doin' great research on
homies as companions, so we
listin' his Lab as splendid number one!
5:
Announcin' the top 3 in 
Cherrygrove City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The roar of the waves!
The roar of the waves from the beach
to the west just make everybody feel
good, don't it?
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
The lil flower beds!
This town got mad lil flower beds
all over, makin' the town that
much prettier.
And number one is... Ta-da!
The Guide Gent!
First time travelers come to town,
the Guide Gent show 'em around
and help 'em out, and that's why he
our splendid number one!
6:
Announcin' the top 3 in Violet City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The arched bridge!
This bridge stretch over the river
runnin' through town, and it's so
round it remind folks of a drum.
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
The stylish Trap House!
This Trap House painted in natural
colors so it blend in with the
beautiful scenery around it instead of
standin' out. Real low-key!
And number one is... Ta-da!
Sprout Tower!
Sprout Tower always slowly swayin'
back and forth, and it's where
Hustlers train if they aimin' for
the top! It's strict, that's why it's
popular, and that's why it's our
splendid number one!
7:
Announcin' the top 3 in Azalea Town!
Number three is... Ta-da!
FARFETCH'D's charcoal!
This town famous for the charcoal
the FARFETCH'D make with stuff they
gather themselves.
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
SLOWPOKE Well!
Also known as Rainmaker Well, SLOWPOKE
Well a popular sightseein' spot.
And number one is... Ta-da!
Kurt!
Kurt a REAL talented Hood Ball
maker, usin' old-school techniques.
He a great carver, and that's why he
our splendid number one!
8:
Announcin' the top 3 in Goldenrod City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Dress-Up Guy!
The gentleman runnin' the Dress-Up
Shop in the tunnel look manly on
the outside, but at heart, he kinda
like a lil girl. But still, he a
all-around nice guy.
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Global Terminal!
At the Global Terminal, you can trade
homies with people all over the world,
so we figured it'd be
real popular.
And number one is... Ta-da!
The Radio Tower!
Sendin' info all over Johto,
the Radio Tower is the number one
sparklin' attraction. And of
course, the show you listenin' to now
comin' from that very
same tower, and that's why it's our
splendid number one! No Feds allowed!
9:
Announcin' the top 3 in Olivine City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Olivine Café!
This café on the beach is famous
around the city for havin' great food.
Everything on the menu BUSSIN'!
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Fast Ship S.S. Aqua!
The S.S. Aqua run on a jet of water
and it's clutch for travelers
goin' between Johto and Kanto!
And number one is... Ta-da!
The Lighthouse!
This Lighthouse a shinin' symbol of
Olivine and light the way for ships on
the sea, and that's why it's our splendid
number one!
10:
Announcin' the top 3 in Ecruteak City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Burned Tower!
The big hole burned into this tower
is a reminder of its long, sad
history. But people still
interested.
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Ecruteak Dance Theater!
You can always hear classy
music comin' from this dance theater,
which is real popular with tourists.
It's so charmin' it make you
wanna get up and dance!
And number one is... Ta-da!
The Bellchime Trail!
The trail to the Bell Tower always
decorated in autumn colors for some
reason, and it's a
magnificent sight!
Regular people can't
go in, but it's still REAL popular, and
that's why it's our splendid number one!
11:
Announcin' the top 3 in Cianwood City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Pharmacy!
This Pharmacy been in business for
500 years, can you believe it? For 500
years, they been runnin' the same
business! The OG plug!
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
Catchin' KRABBY on the beach!
When you break rocks on the beach,
sometimes KRABBY gather up. When that
happen, mad people try to catch
the KRABBY.
And number one is... Ta-da!
The Guide Lady!
This lady guide you down the path
to the Safari Zone with her
rhythmic way of talkin'. She real
popular with the locals, and that's why
she our splendid number one!
12:
Announcin' the top 3 in Mahogany Town!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The fire lookout points!
They learned their lesson from the fire
that happened over in Ecruteak City,
and built fire lookout points,
which landed number three on our
list! Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
Their famous RageCandyBars!
What clever souvenirs! We don't know if
these is good or not, but for some
reason we copped one anyway! That's the
power of a RageCandyBar!
And number one is... Ta-da!
The weird souvenir shop!
They ain't sellin' nothin' special, so
why these customers in black
windbreakers goin' in and out
ALL day long?
It's a weird souvenir shop, and our
station got mysteriously flooded with
votes for it, so that's why it's our
splendid number one! Totally legit!
13:
Announcin' the top 3 in Blackthorn City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Dragon's Den!
I thought this'd be WAY fancier...
It's a place most people can't go,
you gotta have a special invite
to get in...
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Ice Path!
Near town is a entrance to the Ice
Path, where a hard wind always blow.
It's a nice place to chill, which is
why it's such a popular spot!
And number one is... Ta-da!
The Move Deleter and Tutor House!
The Move Deleter and Tutor House
is a great spot for Hustlers who like to
teach their homies new moves and make
'em forget old ones, and that's why
it's our splendid number one!
14:
Announcin' the top 3 in Pallet Town!
Number three is... Ta-da!
Red's House!
Red out on a journey right now and
been away from his house a minute,
but his house still our number three!
I wonder where he went...
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
Blue's House!
The Hustler Blue got real skills,
and they say he don't lose to Red, which
is why he in our number two spot!
And number one is... Ta-da!
Professor Oak's Lab!
Obviously, if you talkin' Pallet
Town, you can't leave out the top
homie research spot, Professor
Oak's Lab! It's only natural
this our number one!
15:
Announcin' the top 3 in Viridian City!
Number three is... Ta-da! The
streetlights! Not normally a stand-out
feature, but in this small city when it
get dark, the streetlights come on
and add a beautiful vibe to the town.
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
Viridian Block! This Block's trick is
four different kinds of neon lightin'
up the floor, which give the Block a
beautiful glow. And number one
is... Ta-da! The Hustler House!
Viridian's newest attraction
is the Hustler House. It's where you can
scrap Hustlers you linked with on
your Pokéwalker, and that's why it's our
splendid number one!
16:
Announcin' the top 3 in Pewter City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The huge flower bed!
The flowers in this flower
bed bring a certain warmth to the hearts
of everybody in town.
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
The travelin' grandpa!
Sometimes when he out on a journey,
he find some weird stuff. This
travel-lovin' grandpa landed our
number two spot!
And number one is... Ta-da!
The Museum of Science!
This SUPER popular museum know
how to bring back ancient
Fossils, and that's why it's our number
one! Congrats!
17:
Announcin' the top 3 in Cerulean City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Bike Shop!
This our number three, but
there's been gossip it's gon'
get turned into a shop sellin'
pool floaties. We wonder if there's
any truth to that?
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Gold Grill Bridge!
Together with the high cape, this a
REAL popular date spot.
And number one is... Ta-da!
Cerulean Cave!
Only people who beat every Block
in Kanto can go in this cave!
That's why everybody dyin' to get in,
and that's why it's our splendid
number one!
18:
Announcin' the top 3 in Lavender Town!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Name Rater!
This gentleman who can give our
homies even better names slid into
our number three!
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Kanto Radio Tower!
Not quite as fire as the Radio
Tower in Goldenrod, but still impressive
in its own right. No wonder everybody
love the radio so much!
And number one is... Ta-da!
The House of Memories!
For homies that lived their lives to
the fullest with their trusted Hustlers.
We polled all the homie fans
out there, and this was overwhelmingly
voted number one! Rest up, homies.
19:
Announcin' the top 3 in Vermilion City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The construction site!
It might just be a old man with
MACHOP, smoothin' out the dirt, but this
lot been empty SO long,
with no sign of buildin', that it
got real famous in Vermilion for
some reason.
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
Vermilion Pier Gate!
The pier gate at the boat dock got
this floor you can see through to the
sea below.
And number one is... Ta-da!
The Homie Fan Club!
Obviously this number one! And
once the fan club President hear
it, he gon' talk ANYBODY'S ear off,
won't he!
20:
Announcin' the top 3 in Celadon City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Celadon Condos!
These condos real popular.
Not just popular enough for number
three on our list, but popular enough
for GAME FREAK to move in!
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Eatathon!
The Eatathon held every now and then
at the restaurant in Celadon is so
popular people come from as far
as the Sinnoh region just
to compete!
And number one is... Ta-da!
The Celadon Dept. Store!
From old heads to youngbloods, this
store is the center of social
life, and it got a crazy
number of votes to be number one!
21:
Announcin' the top 3 in Fuchsia City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The Fuchsia City Block!
The first Block Boss Koga went on to
join the Elite Four and left the
Block to his daughter Janine.
Her doin' her daughterly duty seem
to be where the votes came from.
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Pal Park!
Oh, this unexpected, ain't it! I was
SURE this'd be number one, but the
Pal Park finished in second place.
So what's in first? Ta-da!
The trio of AIPOM!
I see! Seem like everybody really
love the Pal Park Warden's prized
three AIPOM that live with him!
22:
Announcin' the top 3 in Cinnabar!
Number three is... Ta-da!
The volcano!
Since the day the volcano erupted
and washed away the town, the mouth of
the volcano still open.
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
...
...
...Huh?
There ain't no number two?
...What?
Ain't no number one either?
Well, I guess that make sense. I bet
as they rebuild the town, new popular
spots gon' pop up. We'll be watchin'
Cinnabar, waitin' to see what
happen!
23:
Announcin' the top 3 in Saffron City!
Number three is... Ta-da!
Mr. Psychic!
This the psychic gentleman everybody in
town know and call Mr. Psychic!
Movin' on, number two is... Ta-da!
The Fighting Dojo!
They say the Dojo owner is a
Karate King. This Dojo a spot for
Hustlers who love to scrap to gather
and chop it up.
And number one is... Ta-da!
Silph Co.!
This was just like we expected, huh?
Like you might know, Silph Co. make all
kinds of inventions and appliances,
and that's why it's our splendid
number one!
